risks.risk: Battery may be degraded or not hold charge
risks.proof: A video showing the laptop running on battery for at least 30 minutes, or a screenshot of battery health from Windows Powercfg or similar tool.
risks.if_unproven: priced as having weak or dead battery

risks.risk: RAM may be less than 4GB or faulty
risks.proof: A screenshot of the system information window showing installed RAM, or a video of the laptop running a memory test.
risks.if_unproven: priced as having 2GB or less RAM

risks.risk: Storage may be less than 500GB or a slow HDD
risks.proof: A screenshot of the Disk Management tool or a video showing the drive size and type (HDD/SSD).
risks.if_unproven: priced as having 250GB or smaller HDD

risks.risk: OS may not be Windows 10 or may be unlicensed
risks.proof: A screenshot of the Windows Settings > System > About page showing OS version and activation status.
risks.if_unproven: priced as having no OS or pirated OS

risks.risk: Laptop may have physical damage or non-functional ports
risks.proof: A close-up video showing all ports (USB, HDMI, etc.) and testing them with devices, and a full inspection of the screen for dead pixels or cracks.
risks.if_unproven: priced as having damaged ports or screen
